description: Use this when the user compares or asks about 2 to 4 connectors. Takes slugs from search_connectors, list_changes or the user; known slugs need no search. Shows a card for each, side by side, with stores, rank in ChatGPT and Claude, tool count by type (read, change, destructive), interactive UI and sign-in. For 5 or more, use render_connector_table; for one, render_connector_detail. The user sees every one of these facts on the cards, so do not restate them as a table or list: answer in one to three sentences on what differs and what it means for the user.

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

slugs.description: 2 to 4 slugs, from search_connectors or another tool, in the order to show

name: render_connector_compare
title: Compare connectors
